verdict.rationale: Asana documents an official MCP server, confirmed by a probe of its docs page. The docs cover a natural-language task and project management guide, a page for connecting MCP clients, an integration guide for pre-registering MCP apps in the developer console, and a tools reference listing read tools and interactive confirmation-UI tools for Claude and ChatGPT. missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration that agents connect and work reliably via the MCP server.
